Scenario fixture: object-text-alternative-present (“<object> must provide a text alternative”)

This file intentionally includes edge cases to test eligibility, presentation-role exclusion, and whole-rule outcomes. Each test object has a stable id of the form object_case_XX.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: visible <object> with no fallback and no accessible name
Missing fallback and name.
02 — PASS: fallback text present
Fallback text counts as text alternative.
03 — PASS: fallback element content present
TextContent extracted from element fallback counts.
04 — PASS: aria-label provides name
ARIA name counts.
05 — PASS: aria-labelledby provides name
Quarterly revenue chart ARIA idref name counts.
06 — PASS: title attribute (best-effort)
Title is accepted as a last resort.

B. Eligibility suppression (ineligible)

07 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable (no occurrence)
Ineligible per helper.
09 — INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor
Ineligible per helper.
13 — INELIGIBLE: inside <template>
Non-composed template content is ineligible.
14 — INELIGIBLE: display:none
display:none makes it ineligible.
15 — INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
visibility:hidden makes it ineligible.

C. Eligibility exceptions

08 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0)
Hidden regardless of focusability; aria-hidden-focus reports it instead.

D. Guardrails: not excluded (still eligible)

10 — FAIL: opacity:0 should remain eligible
Opacity does not exclude eligibility; missing text alternative => fail.
11 — FAIL: offscreen should remain eligible
Offscreen does not exclude eligibility; missing text alternative => fail.
12 — FAIL: zero-size container should remain eligible
Zero-size does not exclude eligibility; missing text alternative => fail.

E. Presentation role exclusion (like <img>)

16 — EXCLUDED: role=presentation and not focusable (no occurrence)
Excluded by rule when not focusable.
17 — FAIL: role=presentation but focusable is applicable
Focusable => not excluded; missing text alternative => fail.

F. Fallback content edge cases

18 — FAIL: whitespace-only fallback content does not count
Fallback content that trims to empty is not a valid text alternative.

End of fixture.
